How we interview

Our process has four stages and normally takes two weeks.

  1. Step 1. Recruiter screen, 30 minutes, covering your background and what you are looking for.
  2. Step 2. Take-home exercise. A small service you build in your own time, timeboxed to three hours, submitted with a README explaining your trade-offs.
  3. Step 3. System design interview. We discuss scaling the take-home to a real fleet, covering queues, back-pressure and failure modes.
  4. Step 4. Values interview with the hiring manager, focused on how you work with others and how you handle disagreement.

We make an offer within two working days of the final stage.
